programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u061/system/state/workspace/programs')

p=programs/'task-ec7bf0ca.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Move all non-background cells down one row."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != background:
                out[r + 1][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.read_text())
